description: Real-fruit gummy vitamin brand for kids and families, based in Countryside, Illinois. evidence.summary: Llama Naturals runs its affiliate program through its own Superfiliate portal; the sign-up page states affiliates earn 20% commission and give their audience 15% off. The brand's homepage reports 300K+ happy families, 2M+ bottles sold and 10K+ five-star reviews, calls its Kids Multi the number-one whole-food kids vitamin based on Amazon.com sales in 2025, and gives the company address as Llama Naturals, 5324 East Avenue, Countryside, Illinois.
